typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FileName as string (),
	FinalOutboundFileName as string (),
	FinalPRFRecordCount as string (),
	InitialOutboundFileName as string (),
	InitialPRFRecordCount as string (),
	OracleDataSource as string (),
	OraclePassword as string (),
	OracleProvider as string (),
	OracleUserID as string (),
	OutboundFilePath as string (),
	OutReportName as string (),
	OutReportPath as string ()
}

source(output(
		FINAL_PRF_RECORD_COUNT as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT COUNT(1)+1  AS FINAL_PRF_RECORD_COUNT FROM (     SELECT              LTRIM(RTRIM(PRFO.RECORD_TYPE)) AS RECORD_TYPE,             LTRIM(RTRIM(PRFO.RID)) AS RID,             TO_CHAR(PRFO.BENEFIT_PER_EFF_DT,\'mmddyyyy\') AS BENEFIT_PER_EFF_DT,             TO_CHAR(PRFO.BENEFIT_PER_TERM_DT,\'mmddyyyy\') AS BENEFIT_PER_TERM_DT,             TO_CHAR(PRFO.MCE_EFF_DT,\'mmddyyyy\') AS MCE_EFF_DT,             TO_CHAR(PRFO.MCE_TERM_DT,\'mmddyyyy\') AS MCE_TERM_DT,             TO_CHAR(PRFO.MONTHS_MEM_INCURRED) AS MONTHS_MEM_INCURRED,             TO_CHAR(PRFO.MONTHS_ARREARS) AS MONTHS_ARREARS,             TO_CHAR(PRFO.INCURRED_MONTH_REMAINING) AS INCURRED_MONTH_REMAINING,             TO_CHAR(PRFO.LAST_PAC_AMT) AS LAST_PAC_AMT,             TO_CHAR(PRFO.STATE_PAC_FUNDED) AS STATE_PAC_FUNDED,             TO_CHAR(PRFO.MEM_PAY_PRIOR_MCE) AS MEM_PAY_PRIOR_MCE,             TO_CHAR(PRFO.MEM_ROLLOVER_DISC_AMT) AS MEM_ROLLOVER_DISC_AMT,             TO_CHAR(PRFO.STATE_DISC_PERCENTAGE) AS STATE_DISC_PERCENTAGE,             TO_CHAR(PRFO.STATE_ROLLOVER_DISC_AMT) AS STATE_ROLLOVER_DISC_AMT,             TO_CHAR(PRFO.TOTAL_ROLLOVER_DISC_AMT) AS TOTAL_ROLLOVER_DISC_AMT,             TO_CHAR(PRFO.MEM_OVERPAYMENTS) AS MEM_OVERPAYMENTS,             TO_CHAR(PRFO.MEM_ACT_CASH_PAY) AS MEM_ACT_CASH_PAY,             TO_CHAR(PRFO.STATE_CONTRIBUTION) AS STATE_CONTRIBUTION,             TO_CHAR(PRFO.MEM_REQ_CONT_ENROLLED) AS MEM_REQ_CONT_ENROLLED,             TO_CHAR(PRFO.MEM_ROLLOVER_PAY_APPLIED) AS MEM_ROLLOVER_PAY_APPLIED,             TO_CHAR(PRFO.MEM_PAYMENTS) AS MEM_PAYMENTS,             TO_CHAR(PRFO.STATE_DISCOUNT_AMT) AS STATE_DISCOUNT_AMT,             TO_CHAR(PRFO.STATE_PAC_FUNDED_BALANCE) AS STATE_PAC_FUNDED_BALANCE,             TO_CHAR(PRFO.MEM_CLAIMS_PAID_BY_MCE) AS MEM_CLAIMS_PAID_BY_MCE,             TO_CHAR(PRFO.STATE_CLAIMS_PAID_BY_MCE) AS STATE_CLAIMS_PAID_BY_MCE,             TO_CHAR(PRFO.TOTAL_CLAIMS_PAID_BY_MCE) AS TOTAL_CLAIMS_PAID_BY_MCE,             TO_CHAR(PRFO.MEM_PENALTY) AS MEM_PENALTY,             TO_CHAR(PRFO.MEM_REFUND_AMT) AS MEM_REFUND_AMT,             TO_CHAR(PRFO.STATE_PAC_REFUND_AMT) AS STATE_PAC_REFUND_AMT,             TO_CHAR(PRFO.TOTAL_REFUND_WITH_PEN_AMT) AS TOTAL_REFUND_WITH_PEN_AMT,             TO_CHAR(PRFO.MEM_DEBT) AS MEM_DEBT,             TO_CHAR(PRFO.MEM_UNFUNDED_DEBT_CMSCAP) AS MEM_UNFUNDED_DEBT_CMSCAP,             LTRIM(RTRIM(PRFO.PREVENTATIVE_SERVICES_FLAG)) AS PREVENTATIVE_SERVICES_FLAG,             TO_CHAR(PRFO.MEM_STATE_RECOUP_ROLLOVER) AS MEM_STATE_RECOUP_ROLLOVER,             TO_CHAR(PRFO.MEM_PRIOR_YEAR_DISC_REFUND) AS MEM_PRIOR_YEAR_DISC_REFUND,             TO_CHAR(PRFO.STATE_PRIOR_YEAR_DISC_REFUND) AS STATE_PRIOR_YEAR_DISC_REFUND,             TO_CHAR(PRFO.MEM_ROLLOVER_PAID_PRIOR_MCE) AS MEM_ROLLOVER_PAID_PRIOR_MCE,             TO_CHAR(PRFO.MEM_OVERPAY_BY_DISCOUNT) AS MEM_OVERPAY_BY_DISCOUNT,             TO_CHAR(PRFO.DEBT_COLL_PRIOR_DEBT) AS DEBT_COLL_PRIOR_DEBT,             TO_CHAR(PRFO.STATE_ROLLOVER_PAID_PRIOR_MCE) AS STATE_ROLLOVER_PAID_PRIOR_MCE,             TO_CHAR(PRFO.MEM_PRIOR_YEAR_DISC_AMT) AS MEM_PRIOR_YEAR_DISC_AMT,             TO_CHAR(PRFO.STATE_PRIOR_YEAR_DISC_AMT) AS STATE_PRIOR_YEAR_DISC_AMT     FROM AGP.PRF_CALC_OUTPUT_MAPPING PRFO     JOIN AGP.PRF_CALC_INPUT_MAPPING PRFI          ON PRFO.RID = PRFI.RID          AND PRFO.BENEFIT_PER_EFF_DT = PRFI.BENEFIT_PER_EFF_DT                        UNION      SELECT              LTRIM(RTRIM(PRFR.RECORD_TYPE)) AS RECORD_TYPE,             LTRIM(RTRIM(PRFR.RID)) AS RID,             TO_CHAR(PRFR.BENEFIT_PER_EFF_DT,\'mmddyyyy\') AS BENEFIT_PER_EFF_DT,             TO_CHAR(PRFR.BENEFIT_PER_TERM_DT,\'mmddyyyy\') AS BENEFIT_PER_TERM_DT,             TO_CHAR(PRFR.MCE_EFF_DT,\'mmddyyyy\') AS MCE_EFF_DT,             TO_CHAR(PRFR.MCE_TERM_DT,\'mmddyyyy\') AS MCE_TERM_DT,             TO_CHAR(PRFR.MONTHS_MEM_INCURRED) AS MONTHS_MEM_INCURRED,             TO_CHAR(PRFR.MONTHS_ARREARS) AS MONTHS_ARREARS,             TO_CHAR(PRFR.INCURRED_MONTH_REMAINING) AS INCURRED_MONTH_REMAINING,             TO_CHAR(PRFR.LAST_PAC_AMT) AS LAST_PAC_AMT,             TO_CHAR(PRFR.STATE_PAC_FUNDED) AS STATE_PAC_FUNDED,             TO_CHAR(PRFR.MEM_PAY_PRIOR_MCE) AS MEM_PAY_PRIOR_MCE,             TO_CHAR(PRFR.MEM_ROLLOVER_DISC_AMT) AS MEM_ROLLOVER_DISC_AMT,             TO_CHAR(PRFR.STATE_DISC_PERCENTAGE) AS STATE_DISC_PERCENTAGE,             TO_CHAR(PRFR.STATE_ROLLOVER_DISC_AMT) AS STATE_ROLLOVER_DISC_AMT,             TO_CHAR(PRFR.TOTAL_ROLLOVER_DISC_AMT) AS TOTAL_ROLLOVER_DISC_AMT,             TO_CHAR(PRFR.MEM_OVERPAYMENTS) AS MEM_OVERPAYMENTS,             TO_CHAR(PRFR.MEM_ACT_CASH_PAY) AS MEM_ACT_CASH_PAY,             TO_CHAR(PRFR.STATE_CONTRIBUTION) AS STATE_CONTRIBUTION,             TO_CHAR(PRFR.MEM_REQ_CONT_ENROLLED) AS MEM_REQ_CONT_ENROLLED,             TO_CHAR(PRFR.MEM_ROLLOVER_PAY_APPLIED) AS MEM_ROLLOVER_PAY_APPLIED,             TO_CHAR(PRFR.MEM_PAYMENTS) AS MEM_PAYMENTS,             TO_CHAR(PRFR.STATE_DISCOUNT_AMT) AS STATE_DISCOUNT_AMT,             TO_CHAR(PRFR.STATE_PAC_FUNDED_BALANCE) AS STATE_PAC_FUNDED_BALANCE,             TO_CHAR(PRFR.MEM_CLAIMS_PAID_BY_MCE) AS MEM_CLAIMS_PAID_BY_MCE,             TO_CHAR(PRFR.STATE_CLAIMS_PAID_BY_MCE) AS STATE_CLAIMS_PAID_BY_MCE,             TO_CHAR(PRFR.TOTAL_CLAIMS_PAID_BY_MCE) AS TOTAL_CLAIMS_PAID_BY_MCE,             TO_CHAR(PRFR.MEM_PENALTY) AS MEM_PENALTY,             TO_CHAR(PRFR.MEM_REFUND_AMT) AS MEM_REFUND_AMT,             TO_CHAR(PRFR.STATE_PAC_REFUND_AMT) AS STATE_PAC_REFUND_AMT,             TO_CHAR(PRFR.TOTAL_REFUND_WITH_PEN_AMT) AS TOTAL_REFUND_WITH_PEN_AMT,             TO_CHAR(PRFR.MEM_DEBT) AS MEM_DEBT,             TO_CHAR(PRFR.MEM_UNFUNDED_DEBT_CMSCAP) AS MEM_UNFUNDED_DEBT_CMSCAP,             LTRIM(RTRIM(PRFR.PREVENTATIVE_SERVICES_FLAG)) AS PREVENTATIVE_SERVICES_FLAG,             TO_CHAR(PRFR.MEM_STATE_RECOUP_ROLLOVER) AS MEM_STATE_RECOUP_ROLLOVER,             TO_CHAR(PRFR.MEM_PRIOR_YEAR_DISC_REFUND) AS MEM_PRIOR_YEAR_DISC_REFUND,             TO_CHAR(PRFR.STATE_PRIOR_YEAR_DISC_REFUND) AS STATE_PRIOR_YEAR_DISC_REFUND,             TO_CHAR(PRFR.MEM_ROLLOVER_PAID_PRIOR_MCE) AS MEM_ROLLOVER_PAID_PRIOR_MCE,             TO_CHAR(PRFR.MEM_OVERPAY_BY_DISCOUNT) AS MEM_OVERPAY_BY_DISCOUNT,             TO_CHAR(PRFR.DEBT_COLL_PRIOR_DEBT) AS DEBT_COLL_PRIOR_DEBT,             TO_CHAR(PRFR.STATE_ROLLOVER_PAID_PRIOR_MCE) AS STATE_ROLLOVER_PAID_PRIOR_MCE,             TO_CHAR(PRFR.MEM_PRIOR_YEAR_DISC_AMT) AS MEM_PRIOR_YEAR_DISC_AMT,             TO_CHAR(PRFR.STATE_PRIOR_YEAR_DISC_AMT) AS STATE_PRIOR_YEAR_DISC_AMT     FROM AGP.PRF_REJECTED PRFR             )',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> FetchFinalPRFRecordCount
FetchFinalPRFRecordCount sink(input(
		FINAL_PRF_RECORD_COUNT as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		FINAL_PRF_RECORD_COUNT)) ~> FinalPRFWriteRecordCountinTrailer
